text: Sino Argentina Group aspires to be the definitive strategic commercial bridge between Argentina and China for our clients.

Looking at the different companies as cooperators to strengthen and add value to the production chain, achieving greater efficiency in quality and value through our outstanding comprehensive commercial service and deep cultural understanding of both nations. whyUs.title: WHY US
whyUs.text_card_1: At Sino Argentina Group, we have strategically located offices in Guangzhou, China, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. This duality allows us to provide a comprehensive service that covers every detail of import and export procedures, ensuring a fluid and effective connection between both markets.
whyUs.text_card_2: Our team of bilingual professionals based in China have an advanced command of Chinese and Spanish, ensuring clear communication without cultural or language barriers. This positions us as a reliable partner for your international business.
whyUs.text_card_3: We understand the challenges of finding reliable suppliers in China and securing serious buyers for your exports. We specialize in preventing fraud and scams, providing customized solutions that ensure the success of your business operations.
whyUs.text_card_4: From finding suppliers and customers to complete logistics, we take care of every step of the process. We offer alternatives tailored to your needs, negotiate the best conditions and supervise every detail so that your products arrive at their destination without problems.

RoadMap.title: STEP BY STEP IN ANALYSIS, NEGOTIATION AND PURCHASES WITH SUPPLIERS IN CHINA

mapCard.text_1: A meeting is held where the client provides details about the product to be sought (technical specifications, quantity, quality, etc.). Certification and compliance requirements are then defined. Finally, an estimated budget is established.
mapCard.text_2: A thorough search is conducted in specialized databases and e-commerce platforms. Multiple suppliers are contacted and evaluated based on their reputation, production capacity and prices. Detailed product information, samples and catalogues are requested.
mapCard.text_3: If necessary, factory visits are organized to verify production conditions and product quality.
mapCard.text_4: Prices, delivery times, payment terms, warranties and contract terms are negotiated. The contract is drafted and reviewed jointly with the client.
mapCard.text_5: The production process is constantly monitored, ensuring that quality standards and agreed deadlines are met.
mapCard.text_6: An independent inspection company is hired to verify the quality of the products before shipment.
mapCard.text_7: The shipping details are coordinated, including packaging, transport and customs clearance at origin. Then, the international shipment is carried out, with all international logistics being tracked.
